336: {A single arc taken through everything standing inside its radius | Reach multiplied by rotation equals a great many opportunities per second}. {every body in the sweep is opened and stays open | there is no selection process; the radius performs the selection}.
337: {A spear released is a spear surrendered, which is the objection every drillmaster raises | The atlatl solved this forty thousand years ago and was abandoned anyway}. {the shaft arrives and continues working in the wound | the animal now has no spear, a fact it has failed to consider}.
338: {The creature lowers itself until observers experience something they cannot name | Submission displays evolved to stop conspecifics and are being used on the wrong species}. {three capacities fall and nobody can look away from it | shame is being transmitted, and shame is not a state anyone has a defence for}.
339: {It waits inside cover until observation lapses, and observation always lapses | Patience is free; the sprint is what costs}. {against somebody blinded, upended or pinned, the yield goes up fourfold | if he is watching, this is an ordinary lunge and a wasted afternoon}.
34: {Zhan zhuang, standing post: trained by not moving for an hour, then two | The Yijin Jing has a chapter on becoming heavier without gaining weight}. {Examiner's sheet, item one: drop a plumb line from the crown through the perineum. Item two: push. Item three: if he moved, the hour did not count and is repeated tomorrow | Item four, added later in a different pen: do not tell him which hour is the test}. {the root is the whole doctrine, and it is a doctrine about the floor | someone who cannot be moved has stopped needing to move}. {An hour standing / the knees begin to complain / the complaint is filed | Nothing has happened / the shirt is wet through regardless / that is the instruction}.
340: {The same arc, produced by something considerably larger than the arc anticipated | Scaling laws mean the big animal is not a big version of the small one}. {the rank is opened along its whole width | size does not improve the technique; size improves the outcome}.
341: {Caudal musculature, which in the large reptiles outweighs the forelimbs several times over | The tail is a counterweight that the animal has learned to use as a flail}. {the skull stops reporting for half the exchange | the animal is facing elsewhere throughout and has no need to look}.
342: {Both feet, simultaneously, from as much height as the animal can arrange | Ground-borne vibration travels further than sound and arrives through the legs}. {the rank feels it through the soles and three in ten stop working | oily residue is forced up out of the soil, which nobody expected}.
343: {One circuit of the area at altitude, and it returns holding information | Aerial survey is the oldest reconnaissance and the only one with no supply line}. {a target is designated and output rises accordingly | the animal cannot report what it saw and does not need to}.
344: {It observes a technique in use and begins performing that technique | Imitation is expensive to evolve and appears in perhaps a dozen lineages}. {focus arrives and quickness with it | whoever is being copied is watching their own work from an unusual angle}.
345: {Whatever is currently in the lungs departs on fire | The mechanism is contested; the burns are not}. {the rank is left burning and continues burning | breath and combustion, which biology insists are the same process anyway}.
346: {The exhalation is colder on arrival than the air it travelled through | Endothermy running in reverse, which no textbook permits}. {the whole line is chilled and does not recover quickly | frost forms downwind of the animal at rest}.
347: {A narrow rotating column of grit, irritation and very little else | Dust devils form on clear days from surface heating alone and require no storm}. {the rank is lifted slightly and loses all confidence in the ground | it does no real harm, which is not identical to doing nothing}.
348: {Below twenty hertz, where the sound is felt in the chest rather than heard | Infrasound from large felids has been measured and correlates with reported dread}. {output falls across the rank and the fall is involuntary | the noise is a claim about size and the claim is honest}.
349: {Everything withheld since the beginning of the encounter, released together | Restraint accumulates and accumulation is a kind of loading}. {the deeper the injury already carried, the bigger the discharge | nothing is kept for later because there is no later in the calculation}.
35: {Zui quan borrows its footing from the Eight Immortals, who had been drinking | Li Bai drowned reaching for the moon's reflection, and the form recalls the reach}. {A note in a Fujian manual, in a later hand: the student is not to drink, whatever the tavern boys have been told | A second note, later still, concedes that the first note has never once been obeyed}. {the opponent reads a sentence with the verb removed and answers the wrong clause | sobriety is the disadvantage, and everyone facing it has that disadvantage | the fight is being conducted in a grammar nobody present has studied}. {Eight immortals, eight ways of falling that are not falls, and one of them was inserted by a copyist | Crossing the sea, each by his own method, and the method here is to appear to have none}.
350: {Considerable mass, brought down onto the ground rather than onto anybody | The ground transmits it outward and the ground is under everyone}. {the rank loses its footing collectively | the animal has not touched a single one of them}.
351: {Cognition is suspended and performance improves, which nobody enjoys admitting | The reflex arc is shorter than the deliberative one by a factor that matters}. {focus and two capacities arrive at once | thinking was the bottleneck and the bottleneck has been removed}.
352: {THING FROM INSIDE GRUB GO ON OUTSIDE OF OTHER FELLOW | GRUB NOT PROUD. GRUB ALSO NOT LOSING}. {EYES FULL. NOSE FULL. THREE THING STOP WORKING GOOD | TALL FOLK SAY THIS IS BAD MANNER. TALL FOLK ALSO SAY IT WITH MOUTH SHUT NOW}.
353: {Teeth and claws applied in alternation until the quantity is reduced | Mauling is not an attack pattern; mauling is the absence of one}. {the bleeding continues after the animal has lost interest | there is no finishing move here, only a stopping point}.
354: {A portion is eaten. The nutritional benefit is immediate and the etiquette is not discussed | Cannibalism is common in the wild and rare in the literature about the wild}. {what is removed from one is added to the other | the animal is not angry; the animal is eating}.
355: {It does not stop for the guard, and the guard was the only proposal on the table | Momentum above a certain threshold makes defence a category error}. {the shield fails entirely and two capacities fail with it | interposing something merely changes what is broken first}.
356: {Something considerably older is annoyed on the animal's behalf and responds | Totemism holds that the species has an ancestor and the ancestor is still reachable}. {the figure is very large and did not originate in the body producing it | the animal is a doorway here rather than an author}.
357: {The top of the chain, concluding a meal it began some time ago | Apex predators kill infrequently and finish reliably}. {with three quarters of him gone, the arithmetic stops being provisional | on a healthy target it is merely a serious injury}.
358: {It has survived worse than this and has formed intentions about the pattern | Spite is not a recognised biological drive, which is a gap in the literature}. {the more it has already lost, the more it delivers | injury here is fuel rather than damage}.
359: {The question of precedence is settled at volume and does not require a second hearing | Dominance calls are honest signals because faking them is metabolically impossible}. {the entire rank attends to nothing else | provocation is the mechanism and the mechanism is loud}.
36: {Neidan sites the furnace three fingers below the navel and asks the student to tend it | The Cantong Qi describes the gathering in metallurgical language, deliberately}. {Instruction, verbatim: sit. Do not adjust the sitting. Attend to the point below the navel and to nothing that arrives afterwards. Do not count. If you are counting you have already left | Second instruction, on the reverse of the sheet: whatever you were promised at the outset, it was not this}. {the gap is seen a half-beat early, which is what a half-beat exists for | nothing is added to the body; something is merely stopped from leaking out}. {Mercury, lead and cinnabar are three words for one warmth and none of them names a metal | Ge Hong complained in the fourth century that the texts were deliberately obscure, and then wrote one}.
360: {Something that was asleep beneath the field has stopped being asleep | Large things sleep in places nobody surveys because nobody surveys the underneath}. {one enormous figure and a long silence afterwards | the waking is the event; the strike is a consequence of the waking}.
361: {One motion, performed thousands of times, refined into the shortest possible version | Killing bites in experienced predators vary by less than a centimetre between attempts}. {he is shifted, and the shifting is a formality | there is no wasted travel anywhere in it}.
362: {Quantity substituting for accuracy, discharged in a single event | Spines, quills, seeds: the delivery mechanism varies and the arithmetic does not}. {the rank is opened in many small places at once | three quarters of them are bleeding and none of them were aimed at}.
363: {The animal adopts a form better suited to present circumstances | Metamorphosis is common; doing it on demand is not}. {it is no longer where it was and is no longer what it was | pace and shielding both improve, because the previous body was a compromise}.
364: {The engagement begins before anyone present has classified it as an engagement | Surprise is not a bonus applied to an attack; surprise is the attack}. {on a mark already dark, downed or bound, the return more than doubles | if they were watching, this was only a competent charge}.
365: {It advertises something that is not present and has never been present | Aggressive mimicry: the anglerfish's lure is a modified dorsal spine and it is not food}. {they are charmed toward it and two capacities decay while they walk | belief is the mechanism, and belief costs the animal nothing to manufacture}.
366: {It has crossed this ground before and remembers where the footing fails | Territory is a map maintained by an animal that cannot draw}. {the rank is opened while the animal moves through terrain it has already solved | familiarity is worth more here than strength}.
367: {It arrives wearing somebody the target had reason to trust | The doppelganger is attested across every European folklore and the sightings are always second-hand}. {against the unwary the figure becomes something else entirely | recognition is the wound; the impact is only where it is recorded}.
368: {A shell is a promise, and the promise is kept | The old ones tucked in and let the storm pass over them | Some armor is grown, not forged, and it never rusts}. {The blow that cannot land does no harm | Stillness is its own kind of strength | What curls inward cannot be broken from without}.
369: {Every quill is a question the attacker should have asked first | Some creatures wear their answer on the outside | The bristled hide remembers every hand that pressed too hard}. {Strike it and the strike is returned, sooner or later | The last lesson is always the sharpest one}.
37: {Laozi: nothing under heaven is softer than water, nothing better at wearing the hard | The Taijiquan Classics warn against meeting force, calling the error double-weighting}. {Gloss on chapter seventy-eight, in the version everyone quotes and nobody finishes: the world knows this and will not act on it. Two thousand years of commentary have added the word yet | The commentator then spends nine pages on the word soft and never returns to the chapter}. {the blow arrives, finds a slope, and is filed downhill | what declines to resist cannot be broken, a claim the ribs are welcome to test}. {Water does not argue / it arrives, considers, descends / the stone loses slowly | Nothing here is quick / a century of small dripping / the step has a bowl in it}.
379:
{This working has no first performance. It has a fourth, a ninth and a two hundredth, all attested | Do not attempt to recall the previous line. Recall of the previous line is the failure mode | Count the people in the room and write the number in the margin. You will be asked for it and it will be wrong}. {Nothing here strikes. Everything here changes the terms the target is fighting under | The working is a sentence passed, and the body serves it | A condition is laid on a body the way a law is laid on a town, and the body keeps it}. {The working is performed in the past tense throughout, including the parts that have not happened | Repeat the phrase until the phrase begins repeating you | At this point the practitioner is usually interrupted. Log the interruption. Note that nothing interrupted you}.

{Stand where the practitioner stands. The practitioner is not present and the position is occupied | Declare the coming hour already survived. Produce the notes. The notes are in your handwriting | One: think of a number. Two: forget it. There is no third step. The fourth is compulsory and lasts a fortnight}. {It works because it is described as working, and description is the oldest engineering there is | The ward is a definition. Definitions have never been breached, only revised | The universe is a special case of itself, and the working is a special case of that}.

{Side effects: none reported, several observed, one still present | Do not read this paragraph again. Reading it again is how the second casting begins | Whatever you have forgotten was in the two unprinted steps. It is not recoverable and was probably minor}.
38: {Kyusho-jutsu charts the body's shut-off points, which the old schools refused to write | The Bubishi records them anyway, in verse, with timings given as animal hours}. {Collation of three recensions: in each one a different point has been quietly moved. The Okinawan hand agrees with the Fujian hand only on the temple. No copyist has ever admitted to the alteration | A fourth manuscript surfaced in 1934 and agreed with nobody, which the field took as confirmation of something}. {thin bone over a thin artery, and the discussion concludes underneath it | they remain standing, the detail witnesses find hardest to describe afterwards}. {The technique keeps office hours and closes at noon, the hours being given by animal | Nobody teaches this to a student they dislike, which is the only safeguard the tradition managed}.
380: {Take a coal not yet extinguished. Name it three times. Do not name the ally aloud | Paracelsus assigns the salamander to fire and warns that the salamander does not distinguish friend from fuel}. {the weapon runs hot for five turns and the hand is not consulted | fire is lent, never given; the accounts settle when the charm expires}.
381: {Saturn's hour, saturn's metal, and a vessel that has held nothing warm | The Picatrix specifies lead, patience, and a night without cloud}. {the edge carries cold for five turns and the cold does not thin | frost is not applied to the weapon; the weapon is persuaded to be frost}.
382: {Colorado Springs, 1899: Tesla drove current into the earth and found the earth already resonating | The coil is a transformer with no core and an opinion about distance}. {the weapon holds charge for five turns and delivers it without prompting | grounding is the operator's problem and the operator has been warned}.
384: {Operator, begin. The clock in this room has been removed for the duration of shadow veil. | I speak the Illusion words inwardly, at the rate the programme specifies, which is slower than it sounds. | There is one thought in this room and it is not the property of anyone in it.} {Nothing is made. Something is seemed, and seeming is sufficient for most purposes. | It fails the moment it is disbelieved, which is later than anyone expects. | The working is aimed at the eye and never at the thing the eye is looking for.} {It is not persuasion. Persuasion leaves the other party the option of disagreeing. | The effect is delivered as attention. What is attended to hard enough gives way. | MECHANISM: [REDACTED]. The programme's position is that the words work and the mechanism is not required.}
385:
{Stone, and moss, and the water under both: be kind or be swift, and I will settle for swift. | Good morrow, wind. Good morrow, water. Good morrow, the thorn at the corner of the field. I have come for a thing. | I call the arithmetic between the hawk and the hare, and I set every enemy on the hare's side of it.} {Nothing is made. Something is seemed, and seeming is sufficient for most purposes. | The working is aimed at the eye and never at the thing the eye is looking for. | It fails the moment it is disbelieved, which is later than anyone expects.} {I say the plant's own name to the plant, which is the one word it cannot pretend not to hear. | Grow, grow, grow, and be quick, and be quick because I have asked and not because I have ordered. | Rot, be early. Only this once, and only here.}

{The force is the field's own weather, aimed. Nothing is made that was not already in the sky. | every enemy is not cursed. every enemy is on the wrong side of a season that has been hurried. | Nothing here is summoned. It was growing already, and nightmare fog is only the asking to grow faster.} {Leave something. It does not matter what. It matters that it was left. | Where the working landed, nothing comes up next year. This is known, and is planned around. | It cannot be worked twice on the same ground in the same season, and the ground says so plainly.}
387: {Fire is introduced into the metal rather than applied to it, which requires the metal's consent | Smiths kept the quenching liquid secret because the quenching liquid was the whole trade}. {every weapon in the company runs hot and hits heavier | the blade remembers the forge, and the forges of {nation} remember the blade}.
388: {Boltzmann counted the arrangements, and the count is what the practitioner handles. | T dS = dU + p dV, and every quantity in it can be made to arrive where it was not. | The working is a heat pump run backwards on purpose, which the manuals call an abuse and permit.} {Nothing is added. Heat is taken out, and what is left behind is the shape of the taking. | Cold is slow, and slow is the point: it arrives while the target is still deciding. | Water is patient, and ice is water that has stopped being reasonable.} {The one way road is the only law never once caught making an exception. | The energy was here before me. frost infusion is a valve and nothing grander. | The caster is a body among bodies, and warms and cools with the rest.}
389:
{Take the caster as a source at 310 kelvin and the room as a sink at whatever the room is. | Flux is proportional to gradient. Steepen the gradient and thunder infusion follows. | Q = mc dT. The whole of Thunder Infusion is that line and the argument over which term the caster supplies.} {Lightning does not choose. It takes the readiest way down and the art is the readying. | The flash is the smallest part. What travels is the current, and it travels through whatever conducts. | The charge is gathered, held one breath too long, and let go along the path that was cleared for it.} {Seal it. What is in the vessel now is what will be in the vessel at the end. | One working an hour is what the apparatus is rated for. This is the fourth. | In goes the black, out comes the white, and after the white the red, and after the red nothing is said.}

{A difference is created, and every difference is a debt against the surroundings. | Reversibility belongs to the textbooks. In the field the working runs one way and the caster ages. | Steam does the damage, and the fire takes the credit in every surviving account.} {Tabulated values assume standard conditions. Nobody has ever met standard conditions. | Log the hour, the weight and the colour. What is not written down did not happen twice. | The heat that was borrowed goes back into the room, then the walls, then the sky.}
39: {Go no sen: the Japanese name for winning by going second | Yagyu Munenori called the waiting sword life-giving and meant it as engineering}. {Marginal note, hand unidentified, in a copy held at {city}: the sword that waits is not patient. It is owed something, and it is waiting to be paid | Underneath, in the same ink: the writer of this note did not survive his own advice}. {initiative is handed across like a loaded thing and comes back the same way | whoever moves first has published their intentions, and the publication is read back to them}. {Munenori served two shoguns and wrote that the art is government by other means, which offended both | Give the turn away / the room becomes very quiet / somebody will move}.
390:
{Nine steps sunwise about this company, and at the ninth I begin to speak. | Earth beneath me, sky over me, and the working standing between the two of them. | Nothing is summoned. I say the name of what is here already, until it turns round.} {The air is turned into a hand, and the hand has no fingers and a great deal of reach. | Nothing is struck. Everything is pushed, and the ground does the striking. | The air is already moving. The art is only a matter of agreeing with it about the direction.} {Ask the ground for one season out of the seven it is holding. Never ask for two. | Grow between us and them. Grow high. Grow now, the way ivy grows, which is without asking the wall. | Thorn, hold. Root, grip. Water, rise. Wind, turn about and come from the other side.}

{It works better on ground that has been walked, best on ground that has been worked, and not at all on stone. | Nothing here is summoned. It was growing already, and windshield is only the asking to grow faster. | Every charm is a loan against a season, and the season is repaid whether or not the borrower is present.} {Sit down where you stood. Let the field finish without being watched. | The ground remembers who asked. Ask badly once and be a stranger in that field for a lifetime. | Thank the ground. Not out of courtesy: for the account, which is kept.}
391: {Attempted with the correct materials, the correct hour, and insufficient conviction | Agrippa notes that the operator's certainty is a component and cannot be substituted}. {the weapon becomes slightly warm and stays slightly warm | one time in ten it takes, which is not a working rate}.
392: {Grey haze laid over the whole line, obscuring nothing important and everything else | Fog is filed among the minor works, and the minor works are the ones people actually cast}. {the ground betrays them and two faculties lapse, formation-wide | the damage is negligible; the inconvenience is total}.
393: {The ground is displaced by an inch, under one foot, at the moment it bears weight | The smallest sufficient intervention, which the Italian schools consider the mark of the artist}. {he stumbles and three capacities suffer for it | one inch, correctly timed, outperforms a great deal of thunder}.
394:
{The working is a heat pump run backwards on purpose, which the manuals call an abuse and permit. | n R T = p V, and any of those five letters can be moved without consulting the other four. | Flux is proportional to gradient. Steepen the gradient and magnetic disruption follows.} {The charge is the only part that is directed. Everything after is conduction. | The flash is the smallest part. What travels is the current, and it travels through whatever conducts. | Lightning does not choose. It takes the readiest way down and the art is the readying.} {Seal it. What is in the vessel now is what will be in the vessel at the end. | Every degree that goes in comes out somewhere. I say where, and I say it once. | I count the degrees aloud, and at the number I do not say, the working turns over.}

{Losses go as the fourth power of temperature, so the last few kelvin cost more than the first hundred. | Efficiency never reaches unity, and the missing fraction accounts for every casualty in the literature. | Two hundred joules into a square centimetre does what two hundred joules into a room cannot.} {The practitioner drinks water afterwards, a great deal of it, and does not have to be told why. | Log the hour, the weight and the colour. What is not written down did not happen twice. | The vessel is opened when it is cool, and it is cool later than it looks.}
396:
{I stand in the circle, and standing so I begin Iron Shell. | Hear me, thou that art called by the syllables of Iron Shell. Hear me at the first calling. | Let the air be cut. Let the quarter be opened. Let iron shell come by that opening and by no other.} {Weight is the argument. Nothing under this art moves quickly and nothing under it is refused. | The ground is not scenery. It is the largest thing present and it is being spoken to. | Stone keeps its answer for a long time and gives it all at once.} {Answer in the first hour or answer in the second. Thou wilt answer, for the circle does not tire. | Whatsoever thou art, thou art less than the name I hold. I hold it. Here it is. | About us, about us, about us, and let nothing that means us harm find the seam.}

{The seal binds both ways, and the lighter of the two bound is the spirit. | The circle is not for the spirit. The circle is for the man inside it. | It is done because it was said, and said in the order the old book sets down.} {The ward is unmade at dawn by the voice that made it, or it is not unmade at all. | The lamen comes off last: after the boots, after the ring, after everything. | Nothing is left standing behind me: no name, no character, no open quarter.}
398: {Come forth, come forth, come forth, out of the deep place and into the figure I have drawn for thee. | Let the air be cut. Let the quarter be opened. Let stone skin come by that opening and by no other. | By the lamen at my throat and the oath beneath it, be with one ally until I dismiss thee.} {Weight is the argument. Nothing under this art moves quickly and nothing under it is refused. | Stone keeps its answer for a long time and gives it all at once. | The ground is not scenery. It is the largest thing present and it is being spoken to.} {The company is inside a spoken sentence for as long as the sentence is unfinished. | The compulsion holds as long as the breath that carried it, and not one moment longer. | What is named is held, what is held obeys, and that is the entire art.}
399: {I speak the Illusion words inwardly, at the rate the programme specifies, which is slower than it sounds. | SUBJECT: Dark Trance. CLASSIFICATION: to be spoken once, indoors, by one voice. | I lend them my quiet, which is issued to me and is not mine to lend.} {Nothing is made. Something is seemed, and seeming is sufficient for most purposes. | It fails the moment it is disbelieved, which is later than anyone expects. | The working is aimed at the eye and never at the thing the eye is looking for.} {The ward is a shared conviction, and a conviction held by five is not five convictions. | Information moves and nothing else does. Every other account was withdrawn. | Fear arrives before the blow. Meeting it early is cheaper and is the whole recommendation.}
40: {Sanchin, three battles, tested by striking the student while he holds it | Naha-te maintains that the ground is a component of the fist, not a surface beneath it}. {Testimony of a Naha student, recorded 1932: the master struck me while I held the form and asked afterwards whether the floor had moved. I said no. He said that was the wrong answer and struck me again | The same student, interviewed at eighty, declined to explain what the right answer had been}. {heel, hip, shoulder, knuckle; a chain is worth only its poorest link | everything downstream is invoiced to whoever receives it}. {Three battles: against the breath, against the ground, against the wish to stop | Do not hold the breath. Do not release it. The form is somewhere between those and is not described further}.
400: {REMARK before the proof: the construction is legal, and legality has never been the objection | DEFINITION. A scar is a chart that has been rewritten by hand and no longer matches its neighbours | NOTATION. Points are written x, apertures are written A, and the caster is written as a boundary and not as a point}. {A rule is rewritten while it is running, and everything running under it lurches | The subject of this working is another working. Nothing here touches the world directly | The art is turned on itself, which every art resents and this one permits}. {The proof is constructive, which is the only reason paper heal can be performed rather than merely believed | The body is restored to a configuration it occupied earlier, which the geometry retains whether or not the body does | The injury is shown inconsistent with the surrounding geometry and struck out as an error}.
401: {Coloured smoke into one face, which is a stage effect employed sincerely | Della Porta's Magia Naturalis devotes a book to smokes and considers them philosophy}. {he is unbalanced and his pace suffers | nobody is hurt, which is not identical to nobody being beaten}.
402: {Grit carried on wind, and the grit is not clean | The wind here arrives off ground that has been drilled and the drilling shows}. {every enemy is coated in something that will not brush off | the storm is ordinary; the residue is the working}.
405: {One flake, placed on skin, and the cold propagates outward from the contact | Snow crystals are hexagonal because water is, and Kepler wrote a treatise on it in 1611}. {shielding drops as the chill spreads | nothing arrives except one crystal; the rest is the body answering itself}.
407: {I call the arithmetic between the hawk and the hare, and I set one enemy on the hare's side of it. | By root, by rind, by leaf, by seed, and by the fourth thing that has no name in any tongue I speak. | Stone, and moss, and the water under both: be kind or be swift, and I will settle for swift.} {Water is the medium, and water gets in everywhere it is not stopped and most places it is. | Water finds the way in and takes as long as it takes. That is both the method and the threat. | Nothing is broken by it in the first minute, and much is broken by it in the tenth.} {Growth is the only force here, and growth is patient, which is why it wins. | The ground gives on credit, and keeps better accounts than any bank in {city}. | one enemy is not cursed. one enemy is on the wrong side of a season that has been hurried.}
408: {O thou spirit of stone, hear the voice of the operator, who calls thee by thine office and not by thy name. | The first calling is courteous. Mark that there are three. | By the seal I have cut, and by the ink still wet upon it: come.} {Stone keeps its answer for a long time and gives it all at once. | The weight is the working. Nothing about it is quick and nothing about it is negotiable. | What is stone here stays stone afterwards, which is a nuisance for whoever cleans the field.} {The seal binds both ways, and the lighter of the two bound is the spirit. | one enemy is struck by a thing that was told to strike, and that has no opinion in the matter. | The name has power over the thing because the thing consented once, long ago, and has never been asked again.}
409: {Barely a draught, arranged to arrive under the heels rather than against the chest | Leonardo's studies of air movement treat the smallest currents as the most instructive}. {he is lifted onto his toes and briefly off them | a large effect purchased with almost no wind}.
41: {The low kick is the oldest argument in the manuals and the least respected | Marozzo would not call it fencing; the Bolognese school held views about legs}. {Court record, translated: no blood, no wound, no visible injury, and therefore for two centuries no offence. The statutes caught up in the end. The technique did not change and neither did the outcome | The magistrate's own note observes that the complainant walked into the hearing and had to be carried out}. {no blood is drawn, which is why the courts were slow to forbid it | a knee is a hinge, and hinges have a side they do not open toward}. {The knee remembers / a season later, in rain / the man remembers too}.
410:
{"She fought the urge to flee, pressing herself closer to the dust, her pulse hammering against her ribs" (the Book of Ruth) | "It gave light to all in its ineffable light, and it was given myriads and myriads of powers, so that the Universe might be established once and for all" (The Gnosis of the Light) | "At each gate there is an Overseer of triple aspect having countenances Ingenerable, True, and Ineffable" (The Gnosis of the Light)}. {Anicca, dukkha, anatta. Three words, and the practice of Light Sparkle is the third of them | Kyrie eleison, said once for the body, once for the will, and once for the thing the will intends | Out of the depths I have cried unto thee, and the depths were of my own digging}. {It is gentle with what it approves of and is not gentle with anything else | The light is not owned. It is asked for, and it arrives in the shape of the asking | What is holy in it belongs to nobody present and is only passing through}. {Kneel, and do not adjust the kneeling, however long the office runs | Fast from speech before it and from food after it | One hundred and eight repetitions, and the hundred and eighth is said slower than the hundred and seventh}.

{The correspondence for Alchemistry is written in the old tables, and the old tables are wrong twice on every page | The figure is set facing one enemy, at the same height, in the same posture, in the same light | Work at the hour the thing being copied occurs. Noon copies noon; a wound copies the hour it was got}. {What is separated is purified, what is purified is joined, and what is joined is not what went in | The vessel, the heat and the patience, and the patience is the ingredient that is always short | One thing is required to become another, and both of them object}. {Five. Speak the intention once, in plain language, with no ornament, as you would to a clerk | Three. Bind the figure at the wrists with thread the same colour as force, tying three knots and leaving the third loose | Second: say what you are doing, out loud, in the order you will do it, before you do any of it}.

{Likeness is a technique before it is an idea. A poor likeness produces a poor and unpredictable result | The contact once made is never unmade: what has touched continues to touch at a distance, and that is the whole of the doctrine | Two things that have touched go on touching, and the working is a use of that and nothing cleverer}. {The practitioner washes to the elbow in cold water and does not dry the hands | The old women of {nation} teach it as household work and deny it is a working at all | Say nothing about it for nine days, not even to the person who asked for it}.
999:
{Make two figures, one sick and one well, and place the sick one nearer the fire | Work on a table that has been scrubbed. A table with crumbs on it has other business in hand | Nothing in the working is symbolic. Everything in it is a duplicate, and duplicates are literal}. {Nothing is broken by it in the first minute, and much is broken by it in the tenth | What is separated is purified, what is purified is joined, and what is joined is not what went in | It carries the working the way a river carries a boat: slowly, and the whole way}. {Tenth: do not name the day of the week aloud at any point | Six. Wait. The waiting is counted as working time and is charged as such | Sixth: work with the door shut and the window open, and not the other way about}.

{Third: peel the boiled egg and do not break the raw one, whatever happens next | Eighth: your own wisdom is doing the holding, so do not attempt this at the end of a day's walking | Nine. Remove your rings. Anything that closes a circle on your own body will join the correspondence}. {Strength of effect follows closeness of likeness, and no amount of will has ever made up a poor one | Health is copied from the well figure the way a fire is copied from a fire, by contact and patience | Whatever else is in the room joins in, which is the reason the room is emptied first}.

{The practitioner washes to the elbow in cold water and does not dry the hands | No payment is taken in coin. Bread, wool and firewood are taken without comment | The practitioner does not speak the target's name again that day}.
